Memory for: With the standalone server binary, what command moves me onto builds that track the main branch?
[1] Install/Server Binary.md (Steps)
  Download and run the standalone SilverBullet Server binary.
[2] Development.md (Stack)
  Code structure: * `client/`: The SilverBullet client, implemented with TypeScript / * `server/`: The SilverBullet server library (Rust): HTTP router, handlers, auth, runtime seam / * `server-common/`: Shared Rust crate (space primitives, shared types) / * `server-runtime-chrome/`: Headless-Chrome runtime backend (Rust) / * `bin/silverbullet/`: The standalone server binary (Rust) / * `bin/sb/`: The `sb` command-line client (Rust) / * `plugs`: Set of built-in plugs that are distributed with SilverBullet / * `libraries`: A set of libraries (space scripts, page templates, slash templates) distributed with SilverBullet / * `plug-api/`: Useful APIs for use in plugs / * `lib/`: Useful libraries to be used in plugs / * `syscalls/`: TypeScript wrappers around syscalls / * `types/`: Various (client) types that can be references from plugs / * `bin/plug-compile.ts`: the plug compiler / * `scripts/`: Useful scripts / * `docs/`: silverbullet.md website content
[3] Install.md (Desktop)
  Server: Run Server when you want browser access, a shared team space or a synchronization point for Desktop installations. Install it with [[Install/Docker|Docker]] or the [[Install/Server Binary|standalone binary]]. You can start on this computer and make it reachable from other devices when needed. / [[Guide/Server Setup]] covers setup and administration. [[Install/Server]] describes deployment choices and filesystem requirements.
[4] Guide/Server Setup.md (Install and create a space)
  Install and create a space: Choose [[Install/Docker|Docker]] or the [[Install/Server Binary|standalone binary]]. Start with an empty data folder and open the Server’s address in a browser. The setup wizard creates your first administrator account and space. [[Dashboard]] explains how to manage additional spaces afterward. / The data folder holds Server configuration and, by default, space folders. Keep it on persistent storage so restarting or replacing a container does not discard it.
[5] CLI.md (Installation)
  > **note** This is **not** the server / > `sb` is the optional **CLI client**, it talks to an already-running SilverBullet instance over HTTP. If you’re looking for the actual server binary, that’s [[Install/Server Binary]] (`silverbullet`), not this. You do not need `sb` to use SilverBullet. / The SilverBullet CLI is a companion command-line tool for interacting with a running SilverBullet instance from your terminal. It communicates with the server over HTTP. File commands use the [[HTTP API]] directly. Lua, queries, screenshots and logs use the [[Runtime API]]. `sb help` gives an AI assistant or a person the space’s skills and a map of the space (see [[#`help [topic]`]]).
